bootstrap: paired whole-gene resampling, fixed51 candidates and queries, exact reranking through frequency-weighted ranks
rank_precision: float64, including square roots of integer multiplicities
maximum_pair_selection: from full observed log1p(TPM), same frozen partners for all models and split-half reference; lexicographic tissue tie break
reference: half A predicts half B on common genes and shared full-data contrast partners; uncertainty conditional on saved donor split
retrieval_ties: fractional credit among winners tied within absolute1e-12
invalid_handling: constant profiles make retrieval replicate invalid; report counts and omit invalid values from percentile, no silent denominator changes
validation: weighted-rank correlations checked against explicitly duplicated SciPy ranks; full point estimates cross-checked
